finding: The canonical V7 execution-evidence sidecar has only five built-in model identities. Its policy normalizer reconstructs the model dictionary by iterating those built-in identities, so newly configured Local Factor, PCA-horizon or ranking-horizon contracts are silently discarded. strategy_paths also has no source mapping for those required lanes.
impact: Even after the V7 model source is re-anchored, canonical evidence cannot currently measure or promote horizon-separated executable fills/completions and audited PnL for Local Factor, PCA or cross-sectional ranking. A policy-only addition would silently disappear instead of failing closed.

distinct_from_existing_work.pr_691: PR #691 audits missing canonical V7 LF/PCA/ranking model source provenance. This finding concerns the downstream canonical execution-evidence registry/normalizer even after model code exists.
distinct_from_existing_work.pr_709: PR #709 audits incomplete cost-vector stress. This finding concerns model-family/horizon identity and evidence routing, not cost decomposition.

required_successor_contract: Represent Local Factor, PCA and cross-sectional ranking as first-class V7 evidence families without restoring V3-V6 runtime surfaces.
Keep PCA 30m/1h/2h/6h and frozen ranking 2h/6h evidence separated by horizon.
Preserve the actual Local Factor candidate hold horizon/TTR provenance on each executable observation.
Unknown configured evidence families must fail closed explicitly rather than being silently removed by normalization.
Bind submissions, unique fills, joint completion/partial states, terminal PnL, exact source SHA and cost-stress observations to model family and horizon.
Stress the same frozen observations at 1x/1.5x/2x and retain PAPER-only/authenticated-disabled safety.
